# conradry/open-coscientist-agents — source dossier

**Scope:** M3 static assessment. No upstream setup, agent workflow, or inference was run.

## Pinned source and license

- Upstream: [conradry/open-coscientist-agents](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents), archived 14 April 2026; commit [`a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa`](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/commit/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa).
- Ignored working copy: `references/work/conradry-open-coscientist-agents/`, removed after the M3 release from a clean pinned Git tree.
- Root [LICENSE](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/LICENSE): MIT, copyright 2025 Ryan Conrad. No nested license files, vendored code, or submodules are tracked. [GPT Researcher v3.3.0](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/requirements.txt#L5) is an external dependency with separate terms; the root license does not cover copying it.
- Inventory: 59 tracked files, 17 prompt Markdown files, no tracked tests or CI workflow. The [README limitations](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/README.md#L107-L115) acknowledge no tests/evaluations, synchronous execution, and a 20–30 hypothesis design scale.

## Architecture and inspected areas

- **Framework and model pools:** `CoscientistFramework` orchestrates literature, generation, reflection, ranking, evolution, proximity, meta-review, supervisor, and final report. Its per-role defaults select provider-specific OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic models with no verified zero-price admission; some generation/evolution choices are random rather than task-qualified. [Defaults](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L34-L122) · [generation dispatch](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L216-L257).
- **Supervisor:** a LangGraph node receives the last two meta-reviews, action history, hypothesis and match counts, Elo/diversity trajectories, and literature progress. It extracts a decision/reasoning pair from prose and invokes one of six framework actions until a final report. Invalid actions assert; the main loop has no independent action ceiling. [State and parser](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/supervisor_agent.py#L22-L147) · [decision prompt](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/prompts/supervisor_decision.md#L15-L119) · [loop](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L445-L467).
- **Research and evidence:** goal decomposition feeds parallel GPT Researcher Markdown reports to synthesis. One failed subtopic fails its batch; reports have no normalized claim/source provenance at this seam. The configuration selects Tavily retrieval, OpenAI embeddings, and provider-specific model routes. [Research graph](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/literature_review_agent.py#L18-L168) · [provider configuration](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/researcher_config.json#L1-L16).
- **Prompts and scientific agents:** generation supports independent and ten-turn-capped collaboration; reflection has desk rejection, causal simulation, assumption decomposition and deep verification; evolution mixes top-rated and random seeds. [Generation](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/generation_agent.py#L52-L235) · [reflection](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/reflection_agent.py#L122-L470) · [evolution](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/evolution_agent.py#L86-L180).
- **Ranking and proximity:** all-pairs round-robin precedes a top-`k` bracket; match outcomes and debate transcripts are retained. The bracket docstring says it does not update Elo, but the code does. Proximity clusters OpenAI embeddings with Louvain. [Ranking](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/ranking_agent.py#L207-L310) · [proximity](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/proximity_agent.py#L15-L95).
- **Viewer and operations:** a separate process writes `done.txt`/`error.log` beside goal-hash serialized state; Streamlit polls it and loads finished state. The viewer exposes supervisor rationale/point-in-time metrics, match history, and community graphs. This is viewer inspiration, not durable recovery or authenticated event replay. [Process markers](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/background.py#L19-L66) · [supervisor view](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/supervisor_page.py#L32-L139) · [tournament view](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/tournament_page.py#L124-L217) · [proximity view](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/proximity_page.py#L157-L305).

## Shipped behavior versus claims

The README's real-time monitoring is a five-second Streamlit rerun and file-marker completion check, not agent-event streaming. The README notes that asynchronous scaling and evaluation are absent. The ranking bracket's own docstring says Elo is unchanged, while its implementation updates both ratings. Its supervisor makes an action choice from a prompt, but the framework does not use that choice to assign a specialist model to each hypothesis. These differences are based on the pinned code, not on inferred intent.

## M3 candidate register

All upstream ideas below are **external techniques**. A Google-backed behavior is named only where the retained [paper/extracted corpus](../../docs/CORPUS-EXTRACTION.md) independently states it. No upstream code has been copied.

- **M3-01 — Source's random provider pool — rejected with evidence.** Gap considered: a scientific role might benefit from a specialist model. Upstream [framework defaults](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L34-L122) assign provider-specific pools and randomly choose some generation/evolution models, without per-hypothesis attribution or zero-price admission. Local `app/app/config.py` already has separate worker, supervisor, chat, and safety roles; `engine/src/co_scientist/llm_gateway_routing.py` enforces exact zero-price routing. This particular unqualified random provider pool cannot be imported under the campaign's zero-spend contract. That does not disprove a future *qualified free* specialist model, but the source offers no such tested mechanism to adopt. Reuse: none. Boundary for any separate free-specialist proposal: request identity and frozen paired engine-output evaluation after current-price verification. Added cost now: zero.
- **M3-02 — Supervisor decision visibility — adopted.** Gap: the scientist cannot inspect why the scheduler selected its sequence of research actions on the run page. Upstream [supervisor viewer](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/supervisor_page.py#L43-L139) joins each action to rationale and point-in-time context. Local `app/app/runs_collections.py` already serves an owned `/supervisor-plan` endpoint, with checkpoint-persisted, ordered `allocations` in `app/app/store/supervisor_plan.py`; React's `run_detail_data.ts` does not fetch it and its activity view only renders generic events. Reuse route: independently implement a small read-only disclosure in the existing run activity flow, retaining the local ledger and event replay. Acceptance: an owner can inspect each persisted action and its observable-facts reason/provenance in order, including after refresh; any model-stated `planner_reason` is explicitly labeled as such, never presented as a factual summary; empty, loading and failed-fetch states are clear and accessible; unrelated runs are not exposed. Boundary: API ownership and browser run-detail flow. No model/tool calls or new dependency; one bounded collection request per refresh.
- **M3-03 — Topic research and synthesis — already covered.** Gap: unsourced or shallow background research could weaken hypotheses. Upstream [literature graph](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/literature_review_agent.py#L18-L168) decomposes topics and gathers Markdown reports via GPT Researcher, whose [configuration](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/researcher_config.json#L1-L16) invokes Tavily, OpenAI embeddings and provider-specific models. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/meta_review/research_overview_evidence.py` and `research_overview_knowledge_base.py` already synthesize bounded multi-source evidence with immutable source metadata; `app/app/report/content.py` maps cited sources into the report. Adding this dependency would duplicate the research runtime and lose normalized provenance. Reuse: none. Boundary: existing retrieval replay, citation and report checks. Added cost: zero.
- **M3-04 — Per-idea match inspection — adopted.** Gap: the reader sees only an idea's latest match, so earlier reasons for its Elo trajectory are hidden in the workbench. Upstream [tournament viewer](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/tournament_page.py#L124-L217) lists its matches and debate text. Google independently publishes a [multi-turn ranking debate artifact](../../docs/CORPUS-EXTRACTION.md#L2107); this particular viewer is an external presentation choice. Local `app/app/store/records_matches.py` already persists transcripts, `GET /matches` returns all rows, and `ideas_detail_pane.tsx` receives them but selects only one. Reuse route: independently extend the existing Ideas detail with a collapsed, per-idea newest-first match list and optional transcript; do not change Elo or fetch another collection. Acceptance: every involving match shows opponent, outcome, tier/iteration, rating change and stored rationale; a recorded transcript can be expanded, an older row without one remains readable. Boundary: existing match API plus browser Ideas flow, including refresh/accessibility. No inference or dependency cost.
- **M3-05 — Proximity graph workbench — outside authorized scope.** Upstream [proximity page](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/proximity_page.py#L157-L305) offers Cytoscape sliders, community statistics and graph selection. Local `GET /proximity` already serves weighted edges and the Ideas detail shows cluster IDs. An additional interactive graph would be a new visualization surface and layout project, with no demonstrated gap in scientific decisions or fidelity. Reuse: none. Boundary if separately authorized: browser graph navigation and edge provenance. Added cost now: zero.
- **M3-06 — Process and recovery model — rejected with evidence.** Upstream [background.py](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/app/background.py#L19-L66) reports completion from goal-hash files and a separate process; the UI polls for markers. Local `app/app/task_worker.py` and `app/app/store/tasks.py` provide leased durable tasks, retry/resume, and append-only checkpoints, while `runs_events.py` serves authenticated SSE replay. Importing the source pattern would weaken recovery, ownership, and progress fidelity. Reuse: none. Boundary: existing task recovery and SSE tests. Added cost: zero.
- **M3-07 — Generation and reflection prompts — already covered.** Upstream [generation](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/generation_agent.py#L52-L235) records predictions/assumptions and [reflection](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/reflection_agent.py#L122-L470) probes assumptions. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/generation/assumptions.py` and `reflection/deep_verification.py` already provide bounded, checkpointed versions. The source offers no quality evaluation warranting a prompt transplant. Reuse: none. Boundary: existing generation/reflection tests and the fixed scientific panel if a specific prompt hypothesis arises. Added cost: zero.
- **M3-08 — Source's competed-only random parents — rejected with evidence.** Upstream [evolution selection](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/framework.py#L327-L355) evolves top-rated parents plus random parents from the remaining [competed tournament candidates](https://github.com/conradry/open-coscientist-agents/blob/a20b018300da57a26578f8e7442b890193950afa/coscientist/global_state.py#L390-L401). Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/evolution/evolve_round.py` selects parents that are rankable and not undermined, while `evolve_context.py` samples top and random *context* for diversity. Importing the source's competed-only criterion would drop the local stronger eligibility check; competition alone is insufficient to prove a parent passes it. Thus that exact source policy is rejected, without claiming that a safe random draw *within* the eligible pool is disproven. No concrete local exploration failure currently motivates that new policy. Reuse: none. Boundary if separately proposed: preserve eligibility and lineage, then compare fixed paired novelty and safety/quality metrics through engine-output and ranking/ablation evaluators. No extra inference is authorized by this rejected source mechanism.

## Evaluation and release evidence

M3-02 and M3-04 are UI/correctness changes, not claims of increased scientific quality. No upstream source was copied, no dependency was added, and no campaign model inference was used. M3-02 reads the existing owned `/supervisor-plan` API through `getSupervisorPlan` and shows the saved ledger in active and terminal run views. Its optional fetch does not block the main run, hides the previous run's ledger immediately on route changes, and refreshes once on an SSE transition to `open` so a checkpoint saved before its event remains discoverable. M3-04 renders all stored matches and optional debate documents from the already-fetched `/matches` collection in the existing Ideas detail. It does not change Elo or scientific output.

Acceptance evidence on the integrated branch: targeted API/component tests passed, including error/retry, empty state, initial connection, reconnect, run-id change, older matches, transcript presentation, and keyboard disclosure. The isolated offline Playwright browser exercised a completed run, delayed ledger loading, persistent decisions after refresh, failure isolation, recovery, and match history. `make test-all` passed (engine 3,144 passed/2 pre-existing skips; app 1,874 passed; MCP 283 passed; parity gate passed); `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make build`, `make eval-smoke`, and `make e2e` passed (10 browser tests). The full frontend suite passed 121 files/731 tests with `bun run test --maxWorkers=1`; default and two-worker runs had timing failures in unrelated existing tests while another local Chromium process consumed multiple cores, and those tests passed together in isolation without assertion changes. The capped run executes the same full suite with no skips. `make test-sandbox-linux` is inapplicable because confinement/container behavior did not change.

Scoped end-of-work cleanup found no copied code, scratch runtime dependency, dead export, or duplicated viewer path; TypeScript, GTS lint and diff checks passed. The report-only `kill-ai-slop` scan found no hits in the two changed UI components. The temporary checkout was removed after confirming its pinned tree was clean. The user authorized a GitHub CI exception while hosted jobs fail before execution on an account billing hold; no hosted CI pass is claimed.

Release: [PR #23](https://github.com/guy915/Co-Scientist/pull/23) merged as `103934b616c6e02ba4fcdbd25ffac083156ada69`. Railway API deployment `134fd002-1001-418d-9b25-b74424a4658a` and MCP deployment `a5aef0c7-4880-460f-8b04-ec8c3b31ae3e` both reported success at that commit; Vercel production deployment `dpl_CKuTLYXsnpTVdMb7rXfLTiQAJx2L` reported ready at the same commit and served the public frontend. The API remained one replica with its existing volume UID, database, and off-volume cache settings. The production smoke evaluator passed health, MCP availability, ownership isolation, CORS, and sanitized sharing checks. An authenticated read-only probe of the campaign-owned public PETase run returned the owned run, plan, and matches endpoints successfully; that previously cancelled run had no allocation or match records and was not restarted. In the deployed browser, the public completed *Metabolic Vulnerabilities in S. aureus Biofilms* demo displayed two older matches with outcome and Elo change; its legacy specifications page opened the empty ledger with “No scheduling decisions recorded yet.” The nonempty ledger and error/reconnect paths were verified in the isolated local browser suite. No production inference was started for this UI release.
